lower.method: Actual BCLogo.makeLogo -> BCLogo.png. Four shared per-line parameters; ring-centred baselines. In-sample fit to ref-5 SVG-derived mask, not independent accuracy.

notes: Profiles fit to the supplied tree-source.svg through ref-5 masks at fixed registration.
One face per line; shared cap height, tracking, word spacing and arc bias only. No per-glyph transforms.
The earlier 93.6% per-glyph overlap is not a full-composition fidelity score.
Remaining differences in individual letter positions are not hidden by warping.
